question: Consolidate every finding from the parallelism-foundations run (20260906t162030z-b057b2e795cd, SAVED b173a4e: KF-1..KF-10, N1..N5) and the feature-branch-worthiness run (20260906t165335z-36901387fcf6, SAVED 4b34c06: V-1..V-2, B-1..B-3, C-1..C-3, D-1..D-2, NC-3) into one authoritative finding, and for every gap recommend a concrete solution (decision-ready, with conditions and touchpoints) so the result can be turned into a plan. No plans, no implementations - findings and recommendations only.

tl: Consolidated verdict from both DEEP findings plus 4 new solution-validation tracks: the repo is already conflict-free BY CONSTRUCTION for per-run state, content-addressing, run-unique filenames, and per-worktree isolation. To reach maximum parallelism without conflicts, land nine changes in three batches: B1 mechanism fixes (S8 CI wt-branch filter, S7 per-worktree hook-config resolution, S2 fail-fast pack lock, S3a telemetry partial-tail recovery); B2 safety+merge changes (S1 fail-fast run lease, S6 wt-session merge conflict guard + post-merge verification, S3b durable telemetry loss markers); B3 discipline fixes (S9 AGENTS.md hedge, S5 index insertion under the artifact's own section - empirically makes mixed-class parallel artifact commits rebase cleanly). Deferred with triggers: progress compaction, trace dead code, detectLoss wiring, gate path-scoping, capabilities granularity, index split. Remaining inherently serial: ordered ff-only main merges, pushes, per-merge gate re-runs, CI per push - nothing removes those and nothing needs to.
executiveSummary: Pipeline: two committed findings (parallelism-foundations b173a4e; feature-branch-worthiness 4b34c06) consolidated and extended by 4 read-only tracks: (T1) concurrency-safety solution validation, (T2) serializing-structure solution validation, (T3) ordering/integration analysis, (T4) conflict-free target-state definition with empirical merge tests. Key new evidence: (a) T4 empirically proved in throwaway repos that the .agents/README.md index conflict is an artifact of append-at-EOF placement - two branches inserting lines under DIFFERENT section headers rebase cleanly, so mixed-class parallel artifact commits (research + plan) can be made conflict-free by section-anchored insertion plus a gate check (which also fixes a real mislabel: the builds/ section indexes .agents/csm-build-state/); (b) T1 showed the resume-after-crash path restarts telemetry sequences at 1, so the KF-2 duplicate-sequence hazard survives the run lease in the over-time case - C7 stays deferred but the caveat must be documented for future detectLoss wiring; (c) T3 confirmed run-orchestrator, pack-bootstrap, lib/orchestration-store, durable-json, wt-session are NOT payload-mapped while csm-orchestrate libs/schemas and registry.json ARE - S1/S2/S6/S7/S8 carry zero pack ripple, S3a/S3b require a full re-pack in the same commit; (d) T2 discovered live worktree shims already lack the main-checkout LEFTHOOK_CONFIG override (they resolve per-worktree by lefthook default), so S7 codifies existing behavior in install-hooks.mjs rather than changing semantics. Feature branches remain NOT worthwhile (B-1..B-3 stand). Headline caveats: capabilities.json has no committed generator - a scripts/gen-capabilities.mjs prerequisite must be budgeted before any auto-repack automation; F-033/F-077/F-102 on durable-json acquireLock are open at HEAD, so all new locks are fail-fast EEXIST, ledger-style, never auto-takeover.

keyFindings.claim: CONSOLIDATION: the parallelism-foundations finding (KF-1..KF-10, N1..N5) and the feature-branch-worthiness finding (V/B/C/D claims) are jointly valid at HEAD 4b34c06 and are the evidence base for this change set. No-change verdicts stand for: per-run state isolation (KF-1), content-addressed encoding (KF-3), run-unique filenames making lockless writes safe (KF-4/KF-10), per-run evidence gates (KF-5 eval side), per-worktree isolation (M1-M8/M10/M13 fixed), and feature branches (B-1..B-3 - branches add no isolation).

INCLUDE (batch 2c, after S3a) - durable telemetry loss records (N5), TWO prerequisites folded in: (1) NC-B - createJsonlTransport's writeQueue is a poison-pill queue (telemetry.mjs:110-115): after one append rejection every later write() rejects without attempting, silently dropping all telemetry for the process lifetime - the queue must be repaired on rejection (or markers written via direct appendDurableJsonLine) BEFORE Option A is implementable; this is also a standalone latent bug. (2) Option A markers must be full telemetry events (schema requires eventType/payload/effectiveConfigDigest - telemetry-event.schema.json) carrying the FAILED event's own sequence and full field set, written without recursion into recordLoss; in-memory lossRecords stay as fallback. NC-C - detectLoss contract changes: slot-filling markers satisfy membership+count so detectLoss returns lost:false; loss discovery must move to scanning telemetry_loss markers and the drop test (telemetry.test.mjs:137-160) must be re-specified. Durable receipt/3 extension stays an optional follow-on (not a substitute); do NOT wire detectLoss into the runtime until markers exist; flush-before-receipt reorder (index.mjs:1634-1638) needed at that point. Full payload+registry regen for the schema route.

INCLUDE (batch 2b, after S2) - S6 merge-conflict mitigation (M9/N4), which SERIALIZES-BY-ABORT rather than auto-merging: (1) fail-fast guard in mergeWorktree BEFORE rebase (wt-session.mjs:164-177): if both main and the wt branch touched skill-source/generated paths (csm-*/ sources, bootstrap/, csm-orchestrate/capabilities.json, README matrix region) since merge-base, abort with a deterministic message (rebase in wt, regenerate, commit, retry). (2) post-ff-merge verification at :178 must be CHECK-ONLY (verifyPayloadParity/check-suite) - never a repairing pack-bootstrap write, which would dirty the main tree mid-merge (NC-E) - and must skip when the main tree is dirty (direct-on-main research runs do clean-tree VERIFY). Auto-repack-after-rebase automation still requires the missing committed capabilities regenerator (scripts/gen-capabilities.mjs) - prerequisite, budget separately. Capabilities granularity deferred.

Two parts: (a) writer migration to section-anchored insertion - close-plan.mjs is ALREADY section-anchored (updatedReadme 197-218); the remaining EOF writers to migrate are the four *-host.mjs scripts (honest-failures-host.mjs:360-378, progress-visibility-host.mjs, quality-delivery-host.mjs, renderer-wiring-host.mjs - all scan to the last bullet unbounded by section), the deep-research SAVED index-line flow, and skill-instruction writers; (b) gate: check-suite verifies basename under the MATCHING section, which requires defining directory->section mappings for multi-dir sections (## progress/ cross-lists plans/ JSONs + docs/ + evidence/ files; ## evidence/ holds the research EOF entries; ## builds/ indexes .agents/builds/ AND .agents/csm-build-state/) and re-homing ~20+ lines. Payoff: mixed-class parallel artifact sessions (research + plan) become merge-conflict-free; same-class pairs still conflict (keep-both, rare under one-goal-per-worktree).

No payload ripple (scripts/hooks, install-hooks.mjs, .lefthook.yml, Makefile are not pack-mapped); no test asserts the override lines.

DEFER LEDGER (each with a trigger): C5 progress compaction (trigger: runs exceeding ~10^3-10^4 progress snapshots or measurable resume cost); KF-8 trace dead code; detectLoss runtime wiring (only after S3b markers + flush-before-receipt reorder); C7 shared sequences (concurrent case eliminated by S1; over-time resume-sequence restart documented as a caveat, not a change); full check-suite path-scoping (large refactor, not cheap - validated); capabilities granularity (only if M9 conflict frequency rises); standalone index split (only if same-class parallel artifact sessions become routine).
